title: Private Deploy: Egress Exception Matrix & Offline Upgrade Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines the requirements and acceptance criteria for an 'Egress Exception Matrix' and an 'Offline Upgrade Playbook' for Private/VPC (including air-gapped) deployments. Goal is to provide deterministic, auditable networking and upgrade behaviors customers can operate in restricted networks (allowlisted egress) and fully air-gapped sites while preserving safety (image authenticity, KMS operations) and low-risk upgrade rollouts.

Background & Motivation:
- Customers running Redwood Private in regulated environments ask for a minimal set of outbound endpoints and a documented upgrade path that works without general internet egress.
- Past incidents showed unclear behavior when nodes couldn’t reach image registries or small external services during upgrades; this caused partial upgrades and KV-cache drift.

Goals (high level):
1) Produce an egress allowlist and exception matrix that maps Redwood runtime features to required domains/IPs, port ranges, and TLS expectations.
2) Define an offline (air-gap friendly) upgrade playbook with signed bundle artifacts, verification steps, roll-forward/rollback triggers, and operator commands.
3) Ensure KMS/HSM integration patterns are supported when key operations must be performed without external KMS availability.
4) Provide QA test matrix and runbooks that enable customer self-validation before and after upgrades.

Non-goals:
- Implementation of a custom registry mirror for customers (we will document recommended mirror configuration but not host mirrors).
- Rewriting the runtime for CPU-only upgrades beyond documented fallback behaviors.

Proposed approach (summary):
- Egress Exception Matrix: define entries for feature (e.g., telemetry, license check, image pull, license activation, software signing verification), protocol, domain/IP ranges (where applicable), port, expected TLS cert root (SHA256 fingerprints allowed), and recommended firewall rules. Include an explicit 'no egress required' classification for features that must be offline-compatible.
- Signed Upgrade Bundles: produce an 'artifact bundle' for each private release consisting of: component images (or OCI index), a manifest.json, a SHA256 list, and a detached signature using Redwood's release key. Provide instructions for customers to verify signatures via openssl/sigstore shim.
- Offline KMS Flow: document a wrap/unwrap flow for secrets using customer HSM or KMS: offline key wrapping for secrets in transit, with step-by-step procedure to rewrap during upgrades if necessary.
- Upgrade playbook: preflight checks (node health, KV cache lag, disk space), image verification, staged rollout policy (canary subset inside VPC), drain/resume with KV cache compatibility check, rollback criteria and automated fallback to previous pinned image.

Acceptance criteria (explicit):
1) Egress Matrix completed: a tabular allowlist that covers all runtime external calls. Must include: domain/IP, port, purpose, safety notes, and alternative offline verification steps. (Doc link required: Confluence Egress Matrix).
2) Signed bundle format defined and validated: sample bundle created for release private-2025.03 with example verification steps that run without outbound egress (only local crypto).
3) Image verification works offline: customers can verify SHA256 digests and signers for every image/artifact with tools included in the release.
4) KMS offline procedure documented: at least one tested pattern for wrapping/unwrapping secrets using a customer HSM and a documented manual key rotation during upgrade.
5) Playbook runbook validated in staging: perform a staged offline upgrade in our internal air-gapped lab (staging-agh), report results, and capture metrics (time to upgrade per node, failure modes, rollback time).
6) Rollback mechanism: automated rollback trigger exists if >x% of nodes fail readiness probe within Y minutes (parameters to be tuned; default x=10%, Y=15m). Playbook must include operator commands to force rollback.
7) Zero-Internet fallback mode: runtime supports a minimal fallback (no external model download, no telemetry) and can continue serving with pinned models; documented behavior and limitations included.
8) Security sign-off: Security team must approve the signature verification approach and KMS flow (security_review_required=true).
9) Customer-facing docs: public/private docs updated with checklist, commands, and an FAQ for common firewall pitfalls.

Deliverables:
- Confluence: "Private Egress Exception Matrix" (draft link: https://confluence.internal.redwood.ai/display/PRIV/Egress+Exception+Matrix)
- Confluence: "Offline Upgrade Playbook v1" (includes scripts, sample bundle, verification commands)
- Example signed bundle in GitHub release draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-releases/releases/tag/private-2025.03-preview
- QA report: staging-agh/upgrade-run-2025-03-01 (attached in comments)

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Signature format: prefer OpenPGP detached signature vs. sigstore Rekor + notation. Security to recommend. (Security prefers sigstore; awaiting final signoff).
- Rollback thresholds for large clusters vs small clusters: should be cluster-size dependent. Proposal: use absolute thresholds for small clusters (<10 nodes) and percentage for larger.
- Should Redwood provide a signed 'index' manifest for image mirrors? Proposal: yes, include index.json in bundle. Ops to validate mirror workflows with ENG.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: customers misconfigure firewall and block critical egress; mitigation: preflight connectivity checker tool in the installer that runs only outbound checks listed in the matrix.
- Risk: signature verification complexity for customers without modern tooling; mitigation: provide a minimal verification binary and guided steps.

Notes for implementation team:
- Coordinate with ENG-3471 (image registry mirror work) and ENG-4102 (upgrade orchestration) for hooks and acceptance tests.
- Provide test vectors for QA: signed-good, signed-tampered, missing-manifest cases.
acceptance_criteria: Egress matrix doc published with full mapping and firewall samples
Signed bundle spec and example bundle for private-2025.03 exist in GitHub release draft
Offline verification steps (no outbound) succeed in staging lab
KMS/HSM wrap-unwrap play documented and executed end-to-end in lab
Staged upgrade run completed with QA report and observed metrics
Rollback triggers and operator rollback commands validated
Security team approves signature and KMS flows
